source_policy: Original authored control cages, explicit construction sweeps and finite fitted-part placements. No primitive constructors.

oak_swept_reach.description: Adzed oak chassis reach with shouldered axle seats and narrowed pegged tips.

wagon_strake.description: Curved overlapping cart strake with intentionally uneven adzed edges.

deck_plank.description: Full-length lightly crowned deck plank with wedge fit and real underside.

wheel_felloe.description: Individually fitted 30-degree wheel felloe with explicit continuous inner and outer arcs and a full-thickness mortise seat.

wheel_iron_tire.description: Forged tire arc with continuous thickness and an exposed hammered rolling surface.

wheel_spoke.description: Tapered octagonal oak spoke with thicker mortise shoulders.

wheel_hub.description: Shouldered turned hub with deep spoke seat and projecting axle collar.

forged_rosette.description: Four-petal forged washer and raised clinch fastener.

cloth_canopy.description: Tensioned wagon canvas with hand-shaped sag between five bowed ribs; open ends.

canopy_seam.description: Raised bound canopy edge and ridge rib reinforcement.

carved_drawbar.description: Bentwood drawbar with narrower spring section and shouldered harness tip.

sack.description: Bulging woven grain sack with asymmetrical settled belly, puckered tied neck and loose gathered mouth.

curved_stanchion.description: Continuous naturally crooked oak stanchion with flared shouldered foot and inward upper seat.

ram_hide_roof.description: Overlapping wet-hide mantlet roof, stitched ridgeline, scalloped exposed edges.

ram_trunk.description: Debarked, adzed whole-oak ram trunk: retained uneven growth and tapered impact socket.

ram_forged_head.description: Original broad-brow bull mask, sculpted cheek planes and an armored impact muzzle.

forged_horn.description: Swept defensive horn with changing cross-section and inward tip; original bull heraldry.

hinge_scroll.description: Forged tapering strap hinge with hand-drawn returning volute and separate fasteners.

oil_cauldron.description: Deep hollow riveted iron cauldron with continuous inner wall, substantial bottom and rolled upper lip.

cauldron_pouring_spout.description: Flared open pouring channel with a concave floor, raised sides and a lowered flow lip fitted to the original cauldron rim.

cauldron_bracket.description: Full-thickness swept parapet bracket with curved elbow and raised mounting tongue.

catapult_throwing_arm.description: Continuous crooked throwing arm, heavy torsion heel, tapered middle and spoon mounting shoulders.

catapult_spoon.description: Concave rawhide projectile spoon with raised lip, tapered heel and a continuous deep pocket.

twisted_rope_strand.description: Individually laid rope strand with literal changing section orientations and slight load sag.

ram_suspension_sling.description: Continuous U-shaped load-bearing leather sling under the ram trunk, rising to its roof suspension beam.

joinery_collar.description: Open-ended forged octagonal joinery band with flared upper edge and substantial steel wall.

gate_oak_leaf.description: Full oak gate plank with cambers, sloping weathered top and nonuniform lower edge.

gate_crest.description: Original elongated kite boss, repoussé centre and raised continuous brass border.

wagon_teamster_bench.description: Full-width planed teamster bench with a hand-shaped seat crown, softened thigh edge, end shoulders and mortised supports.

wagon_seat_trestle.description: Splayed full-depth trestle receives the driver bench in its top mortise and bears onto the deck.

limitations: Separate draft horse and actor seat pose are required for the complete caravan assembly.
